cells.reason: The passages contain multiple direct statements by Schwab, Bank of America, Raymond James, Morgan Stanley and Edward Jones about the priority and investment they assign to AI in advice delivery.

items.text: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster states Schwab is already an AI-enabled company, that AI opens new distribution channels and lets it create personalized relationships with clients it could not serve person-to-person, and that AI will accelerate its strategy.
items.quote: Schwab is already an AI-enabled company... Two, AI will accelerate our strategy. On the growth front, AI opens up new distribution channels and allows us to create personalized relationships with clients we have not been able to serve with a person-to-person relationship.

items.text: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster states AI is already having significant impact in driving scale and efficiency and that Schwab is harnessing the power of AI to bring the best of people and technology to clients, with AI accelerating the strategy.
items.quote: AI is already having significant impact in driving scale and efficiency, both in our technology and operations and in the way we serve clients... we are harnessing the power of AI in the Schwab way... AI is accelerating our strategy in several ways.

items.text: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster states Schwab has equipped every one of its 33,000 employees with AI tools and is accelerating the pace at which Schwab engineers build technology.
items.quote: We have equipped every one of our 33,000 employees with AI tools and are seeing tremendous creativity as they are developing fluency in AI... We are accelerating the pace at which our Schwab engineers build technology.

items.text: Schwab states its AI roadmap enables it to further expand its AI capabilities in 2026 and beyond.
items.quote: Schwab's AI roadmap enables us to further expand our AI capabilities in 2026 & beyond.

items.text: Schwab CFO Michael Verdeschi states Schwab continues to make investments in key strategic initiatives including artificial intelligence.
items.quote: We also continue to make investments in key strategic initiatives to support organic growth, new products, client experience, scale and efficiency as well as artificial intelligence.

items.text: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster states Schwab is investing in AI-powered capabilities and that its AI investments support both self-directed and advised clients.
items.quote: We are also investing in our support of self-directed clients, including our AI-powered capabilities... Our AI investments are part of supporting both.

items.text: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster states AI is already driving part of Schwab's revenue gains, including bringing AI to deliver tax and trust and estate insights to clients in its wealth business.
items.quote: I think AI is already driving part of our revenue gains... The other place we're already seeing benefit is in our wealth business, where we're bringing AI to deliver tax insights and trust and estate insights to our clients.

items.text: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan states the company is moving more money into the AI and machine learning side.
items.quote: We also continue to invest in our teammates and are moving more money into the AI side and machine learning side.

items.text: Bank of America reports more than 300 AI/machine learning use cases approved and 114 live generative AI use cases with 34 fully deployed.
items.quote: >300 AI / machine learning use cases approved | 114 live generative AI use cases with 34 fully deployed
items.unit: AI/machine learning use cases approved (114 live generative AI use cases)

items.quote: Advisor productivity, disciplined pricing, digital engagement and AI tools continue to expand our capacity to deliver personalized advice at scale.

items.text: Bank of America Private Bank states it uses AI to support advisor capacity, deepen client relationships, and help teams find information faster and more efficiently.
items.quote: Bank of America Private Bank uses AI to support advisor capacity, deepen client relationships, and help teams find information faster and more efficiently.

items.text: Raymond James CFO Butch Oorlog states the firm is always committed to continuing to invest in technology including AI, that it has been a priority and a differentiator, and will continue to be a priority.
items.quote: we're always committed to continue to invest in technology, and that continues to be a very high priority area. As we mentioned, we already mentioned our commitment level, including AI. That will continue; that has been a priority of ours, but we believe it's a differentiator.

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry states the firm is well prepared to expand AI utilization for financial professionals and their clients in the future.
items.quote: we are excited and well prepared to expand AI utilization for financial professionals and their clients in the future.

items.text: Raymond James identifies Artificial Intelligence (AI) as one of its key areas of investment among major initiatives including advisor productivity.
items.quote: Major Initiatives Advisor Productivity Artificial Intelligence (AI)

items.text: Raymond James's AI framework includes empowering advisors by integrating AI tools into its advisor platform to reduce administrative workload.
items.quote: Empower Advisors: Integrate AI tools into our advisor platform that reduce the administrative workload.

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry states the firm expects to find more efficiencies in the cost structure long term as it deploys AI and automation.
items.quote: I do think long term, especially with AI, we will find more efficiencies in the cost structure, as we deploy AI and automation.

items.text: Morgan Stanley CFO Sharon Yeshaya states the firm's early AI use cases include LeadIQ, an AI-powered lead distribution platform focused on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with its financial advisors.
items.quote: Our early AI use cases, some live and some in pilot, are showing progress. These include... LeadIQ, our AI-powered lead distribution platform, focusing on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with our financial advisors.

items.text: Morgan Stanley CEO Edward Pick states the good that AI will bring as an efficiency and effectiveness matter should not be dismissed and will continue to transform the firm.
items.quote: a lot of the good that AI is going to bring both as an efficiency and effectiveness matter should not get dismissed because that's an important phenomenon that's going to continue to transform this firm.

items.text: Edward Jones states it seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably including technology and artificial intelligence, through its initiatives to deliver enhanced value and impact for clients.
items.quote: The Partnership seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel... technology, artificial intelligence, and regulatory changes, through its initiatives to deliver enhanced value and impact for millions of current and potential clients, colleagues and communities.
